requirement.title: User Login Authentication
requirement.description: User must be able to log in with email and password, redirecting to the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: User enters valid email and password
System authenticates user and redirects to dashboard with greeting

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Successful user login with valid credentials
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Successful user login with valid credentials
Given a registered user exists with email "alice@example.com" and password "SecurePass123!"
When the user navigates to the login page
And enters email "alice@example.com" and password "SecurePass123!"
And clicks the "Login" button
Then the user should be redirected to the account dashboard
And a welcome greeting "Welcome, Alice!" should be displayed

requirement.title: Password Reset and Account Recovery
requirement.description: Users should be able to reset their forgotten password via email link and SMS OTP.
acceptance_criteria: User clicks forgot password link
System sends password reset link to email
System sends SMS OTP for 2-step verification during recovery

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Prompt for MFA OTP code on login
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Prompt for MFA OTP code on login
Given a user "carol@example.com" has two-factor authentication enabled
When the user enters valid username and password
Then the system should display the "Enter 6-digit OTP" screen

requirement.title: Crypto & Bitcoin Payment Gateway
requirement.description: Users should be able to pay for orders using Bitcoin and Ethereum web3 wallets.
acceptance_criteria: Connect Metamask wallet
Sign transaction on Ethereum mainnet
Verify on-chain confirmation

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Complete checkout with valid Credit Card
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Complete checkout with valid Credit Card
Given the user has 2 items in their shopping cart
When the user enters shipping address
And provides valid credit card details
Then the payment should be processed successfully

requirement.title: Promotional Discount Coupon Validation
requirement.description: Cart applies promotional percentage discounts upon entering valid coupon codes.
acceptance_criteria: User applies valid promo code SUMMER20
System validates expiration date and deducts 20%
Cart displays discount line item

candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Apply valid promotional discount coupon
Given the user cart subtotal is "$100.00"
When the user enters promo code "SUMMER20"
And clicks "Apply Coupon"
Then the system validates the coupon expiration date
And applies a 20% discount reducing subtotal to "$80.00"
And displays discount line item "-$20.00"

requirement.title: Manual Alert Inactivation & Audit Persistence
requirement.description: Outreach managers must be able to retire an active alert and verify that the inactivated record is logged with user attribution in the History Drawer.
acceptance_criteria: Select active alert in Manage Member Alerts panel
Set alert status to inactive with a retirement reason
Verify inactive alert is logged in History Drawer with username and timestamp

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Inactivate alert and verify detailed audit entries
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario Outline: Inactivate alert and verify detailed audit entries
When User opens "Manage Member Alerts" panel
And User sets status to inactive for category "<Category>" with reason "<Reason>"
And User clicks on "Save" button
And User opens "History Drawer"
Then Verify historical row for "<Category>" contains updated by "priority_roster_tester" and status "Inactive"

requirement.title: Alert Boundary Validation & Visual Tagging
requirement.description: Validate mandatory form fields during alert creation and ensure active alerts render an orange badge on the left profile panel.
acceptance_criteria: Enforce mandatory start date validation on alert submission
Prevent submission when end date precedes start date
Render active alerts with an orange background on the Member 360 left panel

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Attempt to save manual alert without mandatory start date
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Attempt to save manual alert without mandatory start date
When User selects alert category "Out of Country"
And User leaves "Start Date" field blank
And User enters notes "Member traveling abroad"
And User clicks on "Save" button
Then User verifies inline validation error "Start Date is required"
And Verify alert is not added to the Left Panel

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Enter end date preceding start date
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Enter end date preceding start date
When User selects alert category "Hospitalized"
And User enters start date "08/15/2026"
And User enters end date "08/10/2026"
And User clicks on "Save" button
Then User verifies validation message "End Date cannot be prior to Start Date"

expected_gaps: Render active alerts with an orange background on the Member 360 left panel

requirement.title: SDOH Barrier Association and Multi-Alert Left Panel Presentation
requirement.description: Support simultaneous display of clinical outreach alerts and SDOH barriers on the left panel with distinct badge colors.
acceptance_criteria: Display multiple active alerts sequentially with orange badges
Display logged SDOH barriers with blue badges alongside active alerts

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Display multiple active alerts with orange highlights
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Display multiple active alerts with orange highlights
Given Member has active alert "Hospitalized" with start date "08/01/2026"
And Member has active alert "Member request - Hold Outreach" with start date "08/10/2026"
When User views the Member 360 Left Panel
Then Both alerts should display sequentially with "orange" background badges

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Log transportation barrier and place outreach on hold
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Log transportation barrier and place outreach on hold
When User navigates to "SDOH" section in Member 360
And User logs a new barrier with category "Transportation" and severity "High"
When User opens "Manage Member Alerts" right panel
And User adds manual alert "Member request - Hold Outreach"
Then Verify Left Panel displays Alert with Orange badge and SDOH Tag with Blue badge

requirement.title: Automated Member SMS Dispatch on Alert Trigger
requirement.description: Automatically send an SMS notification directly to the member phone number whenever a Hospitalized alert is assigned.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger automated SMS payload to member phone number on alert save
Log SMS delivery receipt ID in communication drawer
Allow member to opt out via reply STOP

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Generate automated fax draft when member is flagged as Hospitalized
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Generate automated fax draft when member is flagged as Hospitalized
When User selects alert category "Hospitalized"
And User clicks on "Save" button in right panel
When User navigates to "Outbound_Fax" drawer
Then User verifies a new fax draft is created
When User clicks "Send Fax"
Then Verify transmission status updates to "Sent"

candidate_scenarios.scenario_name: Validate persistent alert indicators while editing member demographic details
candidate_scenarios.raw_gherkin:
Scenario: Validate persistent alert indicators while editing member demographic details
When User updates phone number to "760-005-8907" and clicks "Save"
Then Verify update success notification is displayed

expected_gaps: Trigger automated SMS payload to member phone number on alert save
Log SMS delivery receipt ID in communication drawer
Allow member to opt out via reply STOP
